      "evidence": "src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp changes are purely mechanical call-site updates resulting from the CScriptWitness interface change, not modifications to the kernel API or boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site updates do not make a PR a member of kernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/policy/policy.cpp and memory management in transaction acceptance and orphanage pools are directly affected by the witness memory footprint.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "The change significantly reduces memory amplification from adversarial transactions held in the mempool and orphan cache. Instagibbs notes it 'reduces worst-case at-rest memory usage across orphanage and vectors' and allows the mempool to hold 13-15% more transactions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp solely for mechanical CScriptWitness accessor migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates to call sites do not constitute a mining category change."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and rawtransaction_util.cpp only to adapt to the new CScriptWitness API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC interfaces and returned data remain unchanged; modifications are purely internal call-site adaptations."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds src/test/fuzz/script_witness.cpp and updates benchmarks to test the new CScriptWitness structure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests added or updated specifically to validate the changed CScriptWitness component belong to the component's category, not test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mechanical call-site updates in src/bitcoin-tx.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical edits following from API changes elsewhere do not make a PR a member of tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor span helper addition in src/span.h in service of witness serialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "CScriptWitness is a core consensus and script primitive rather than general shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/script/script.h, src/script/script.cpp, and src/script/interpreter.cpp changes redefine transaction witness storage and interpretation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "This change mitigates a serious worst-case node memory amplification DoS vector during transaction and block processing. The PR description notes that 'worst-case allocated size for transactions kept in memory drops from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU', directly protecting validation resource limits."
    },

      "rationale": "No wallet logic, key handling, or fund behavior is modified."
    }
